title: Application of Eastern Edison Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, Sec. 94G 1/2/ and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 131, for approval by the Department of a change in the Company's Oil Consrvation Adjustment charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in the billing months to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in the billing months of September, October and November, 1986. The Oil Conservation Adjustment Surcharge is designed to recover the cost of coversion from oil-fired generation and its calculation is based in the on the respective cost of burning coal and oil.
